Super Crispy Cheesy Mozzarella Potato Balls 🧀✨ These crispy mozzarella potato balls are golden and crunchy on the outside, soft and fluffy on the inside, with the ultimate gooey cheese pull. The perfect party snack, appetiser, or comfort food recipe! 📝 Ingredients Potato Balls * 8 medium potatoes, peeled * 1 tsp salt (plus extra for boiling) * 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp smoked paprika * 2 eggs * 1 cup shredded mozzarella * ¾ cup grated Parmesan * 1 cup mozzarella, cut into small cubes Crispy Coating * 1 cup plain flour * 2 eggs, beaten * 2 cups crushed cornflakes (or breadcrumbs) Spicy Mayo * ½ cup mayonnaise * 1 tbsp sriracha * ½ tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * ½ tsp dried parsley 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1. Boil the potatoes in generously salted water until fork tender. Drain well and mash until completely smooth. 2. Add the salt, chicken bouillon, onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, eggs, shredded mozzarella, and Parmesan. Mix until fully combined. 3. Refrigerate the mixture for 30 minutes to firm up. 4. Scoop out portions of the potato mixture and flatten slightly in your hand. Place a cube of mozzarella in the centre, then seal and roll into a smooth ball. 5. Freeze for 1 hour, or until firm. 6. Coat each potato ball in flour, then dip into the beaten eggs, and finally coat well with the crushed cornflakes (or breadcrumbs). 7. Heat oil to 180°C (350°F) and deep-fry for 3–4 minutes, or until golden brown, crispy, and the cheese is melted. 8. Meanwhile, whisk together all the spicy mayo ingredients until smooth. 9. Serve immediately while hot with the spicy mayo for the best cheese pull! #mozzarellaballs #cheesypotatoballs #foodtok #easyrecipes #potatosnacks

Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Crispy Rice Salad 🍚🥗 Crunchy, fresh, creamy, spicy… this Crispy Rice Salad has EVERYTHING INGREDIENTS Crispy Rice: 1 cup cold, cooked rice (day-old for best texture) 1 tbsp chili oil 1 tsp soy sauce Salad Base: 1 cups cucumbers, thinly sliced 1 avocado, sliced  1 cup cooked shrimp or protein of your choice 1/2 cup shelled edamame (cooked) 1-2 green onions, thinly sliced Optional Add-Ins: Fresh herbs: cilantro or mint Lime wedges, for serving Sesame seeds  Peanut Dressing: 1/2 cup peanut butter 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp honey or maple syrup 1/2 tbsp toasted sesame oil 2 garlic cloves, finely minced 1-2 tbsp warm water (to loosen) ⸻ INSTRUCTIONS Rice → Toss rice with chili oil, and soy sauce. Spread in a thin layer on parchment and air fryer at 400°F (200°C) for 14-18 minutes, until deep golden and crispy edges. Dressing → Whisk everything until smooth and pourable. Add water slowly until it’s creamy but not thick. *Taste check: salty + sweet + tangy + nutty. Adjust with lime or honey if needed. Salad → In a large bowl, combine all salad ingredients. Finish → Fold in the crispy rice last so it stays crunchy. Drizzle dressing on top. Finish with herbs, sesame seeds, and a squeeze of lime. ⸻ #healthyfoods  #healthyrecipes  #EasyRecipes  #crispyrice #creatorsearchinsights

Nutella Cookie Bars 🍪🍫 Recipe Ingredients: 120g browned butter (½ cup) 100g brown sugar (½ cup) 50g granulated sugar (¼ cup) 1 egg 1 tsp vanilla extract 1 tbsp heavy cream 170g all-purpose flour (1¼ cups) ½ tsp baking soda ¼ tsp salt chocolate chips (as much as you like) Nutella for the filling Instructions: Brown the butter, then let it cool. Pour it into a bowl and mix it with the brown sugar and granulated sugar until combined, Add the egg, vanilla, and heavy cream and mix until smooth and glossy,Stir in the flour, baking soda, and salt until a soft cookie dough forms. Fold in the chocolate chips. Press half of the dough into a lined baking pan. Spread a generous layer of Nutella on top,Flatten the remaining dough with your hands and place it over the Nutella, gently spreading it so the filling is covered. Bake at 175°C (350°F) for about 20–25 minutes, until the edges are set but the center is still slightly soft. Let it cool a little before slicing so it stays fudgy and gooey inside. Enjoy✨ #baking #nutella #dubai #chocolate #cookie

🍗🍚 Brief Recipe — Clay-Oven Chicken Spaghetti Rice 1. Prepare the chicken * Season a large quantity of chicken with blended red pepper, ginger, garlic, powdered pepper, salt, oil, chicken seasoning, thyme, rosemary and other spices. * Mix thoroughly and set aside. 2. Prepare the rice * Heat vegetable oil in a huge pot. * Fry sliced onions until golden. * Add rosemary and bay leaves. * Add moderately broken spaghetti and fry until dark golden-brown. * Add a large quantity of rice and curry powder. * Stir until the rice becomes evenly golden and the toasted spaghetti is well distributed. * Add salt and a small amount of water—just enough for the rice to cook without becoming watery. 3. Add the chicken * Arrange the seasoned uncooked chicken pieces in a large quantity neatly across the top of the rice. * Garnish with round green bell-pepper slices. * Cover tightly with aluminum foil, then place the large lid on top. 4. Clay-oven cooking * Build a large traditional red-clay oven and heat it with firewood until mostly glowing charcoal/embers remain. * Place the sealed pot inside. * Cover the oven and seal around the cover with wet red clay so the heat stays trapped. * Let the rice and chicken cook/bake together. 5. Grilled corn * Peel fresh corn. * Roast large quantities over charcoal. * Turn repeatedly and season with a light salt-water mixture while grilling until golden and nicely charred. 6. Spicy fried ripe plantain * Cut ripe plantain into pieces. * Season with powdered red pepper and salt. * Fry in hot vegetable oil until golden-brown, then drain. 7. Pepper sauce * Fry sliced onions in some of the plantain-frying oil. * Add a large quantity of blended green cooking pepper, followed by a smaller quantity of blended red cooking pepper. * Add Maggi/seasoning cube, curry powder and assorted spices. * Stir and cook until the sauce becomes thick, glossy, rich and slightly oily. 8. Serve Package generous portions of the golden curry rice + dark golden toasted spaghetti + roasted chicken + grilled corn + spicy pepper sauce, with cold water on the side. Then Big Mercy distributes it to the village. 😭❤️
